run_torchao_config_tests: run the TorchAoConfigTest unit tests to verify config serialization and validation
run_torchao_quantization_tests: run the TorchAoTest suite to test int4, int8, and float8 quantization on Flux models
run_torchao_serialization_tests: run the TorchAoSerializationTest suite to verify save and load of quantized models
run_torchao_compile_tests: run the TorchAoCompileTest suite to test torch.compile compatibility with TorchAO quantization
run_slow_torchao_tests: run the SlowTorchAoTests suite to test quantization on the full FLUX.1-dev model
